checks.detail: Frontend, native, Rust and project authorities identify 6.4.0.
Project Format 2/schema 29 and all public 6.x contracts remain frozen.
Aseprite, TexturePacker/common atlas and Tiled import/reimport are deterministic and bounded.
Reimport preserves stable slice identity and the last valid artifact on failure.
Large metadata uses bounded worker parsing and repeated canonical sources use a bounded cache.
Six Resource kinds support shared parents, local-only overrides, deterministic resolution and cycle rejection.
Contextual Overview, Slices, Resource and Animation tabs are connected to the Assets panel.
Compact Asset actions remain contained and accessible, while importer history snapshots reject reactive proxies.
Rig weights, constraints, onion skin, curves, retarget and root-motion preview are connected.
Resources and imported content are validated and included by native/Web packaging.
English, German and Chinese teaching manuals cover the v6.4 workflows.
Implementation follows the authoritative 6.4 checkpoint and task guide.
Golden/malformed content, Resource, animation and performance verifier passes.
All startup templates retain valid gameplay, build and accessibility behavior.
User-style interaction traversal reports no critical failure.
EN/DE/ZH layout remains contained through 200% scale.
The measured pre-fix baseline is retained honestly and the final physics/import/script/export benchmark passes without removing features.
